market.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Price Target for Target Corporation
market.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for Target Corporation to $185 from $170 while maintaining an Overweight rating.

market.headline: Boeing and GE Aerospace expand digital tracking to combat unapproved parts
market.summary: Boeing and GE Aerospace are collaborating to enhance digital tracking systems to prevent the use of unapproved parts in their supply chains.

market.headline: Moderna Officer Stephen Hoge Sells $16.9 Million in Common Stock
market.summary: Moderna officer Stephen Hoge sold 78,375 shares of common stock in mid-November 2026 for a total value of approximately $16.9 million.

market.headline: Income Lab Integrates Financial Planning Software with Charles Schwab
market.summary: Income Lab has updated its financial planning and retirement income software to include direct data connectivity with Charles Schwab, allowing advisors to import real-time account balances and investment holdings.

market.headline: Visa Enables Stablecoin Funding for Cross-Border Payouts in APAC
market.summary: Visa is allowing clients in the Asia-Pacific region to use stablecoins to fund cross-border payouts via its Visa Direct platform.

market.headline: JPMorgan Chase Named Associate Sponsor for Wreaths Across America Radio
market.summary: JPMorgan Chase has been announced as an associate sponsor for Wreaths Across America Radio's 2026 'Escort to Arlington' coverage.

market.headline: Bank of America Named to 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents List
market.summary: Bank of America has been recognized by Great Place To Work and Fortune Media as one of the 2026 Best Workplaces for Parents.

market.headline: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. Files Voting Rights Notification Regarding CECONOMY AG
market.summary: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. has issued a regulatory notification regarding its voting rights in CECONOMY AG.

market.headline: Apple Camera and Photos Software Chief Jon McCormack Departs
market.summary: Jon McCormack, the head of Apple's camera and photo software, has reportedly left the company.

market.headline: Loblaw Companies Limited Declares Quarterly Dividend
market.summary: Loblaw Companies Limited has declared a quarterly dividend payable to shareholders on December 30, 2026.

market.headline: Xylem Enters Commercial Partnership with Gross-Wen Technologies
market.summary: Xylem has established a commercial partnership with Gross-Wen Technologies (GWT) to support GWT's expansion into the industrial wastewater treatment sector.

market.headline: Toll Brothers Announces New Luxury Home Community in Johns Creek, Georgia
market.summary: Toll Brothers, Inc. announced the upcoming launch of Jardin Heights, a new luxury townhome community in Johns Creek, Georgia, with sales expected to begin in mid-2027.

market.headline: BofA Securities Initiates Coverage on Viridian Therapeutics With Buy Rating
market.summary: BofA Securities has initiated coverage on Viridian Therapeutics with a 'buy' rating and a $47 price target, citing the competitive potential of its drug Lumvoa.

market.headline: Neogen Corporation Discloses Regulatory Review of Asset Divestiture to Zoetis
market.summary: Neogen Corporation has disclosed that Zoetis has offered to divest certain assets in Australia as part of the regulatory review process for their transaction, with a final decision expected in early 2027.

market.headline: UBS Adjusts Gulfport Energy Price Target to $210 From $217, Maintains Buy Rating
market.summary: UBS has revised its price target for Gulfport Energy Corporation, lowering it to $210 from the previous $217 while maintaining a Buy rating.

market.headline: Freddie Mac Releases Primary Mortgage Market Survey Results for November 19, 2026
market.summary: Freddie Mac reported that the average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rose to 7.28% this week, up from 7.11% in the previous week.

market.headline: Scotiabank Adjusts Lundin Mining Price Target
market.summary: Scotiabank analyst Orest Wowkodaw maintained a "Sector Outperform" rating on Lundin Mining while lowering the price target to C$45 from C$46.

market.headline: Tesla Developing Steering Wheel-Free Model Y Version
market.summary: CEO Elon Musk confirmed that Tesla is working on a version of the Model Y SUV that will be designed without a steering wheel or pedals.

market.headline: Tesla Commences Commercial Operation of Megapack System in Oita, Japan
market.summary: Tesla has brought a 30 MW / 125 MWh Megapack battery energy storage system into commercial operation alongside a solar project in Oita, Japan.

market.headline: Aramark Price Target Cut to $72.50/Share From $75.50 by Citigroup
market.summary: Citigroup has lowered its price target for Aramark shares, adjusting the target from $75.50 to $72.50.

market.headline: BNY Collaborates with Figment to Expand Digital Asset Staking Services
market.summary: BNY has partnered with blockchain infrastructure provider Figment to integrate staking capabilities into its existing Digital Asset Custody service for eligible institutional clients.

market.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Hold Rating on CarMax, Raises Price Target to $53
market.summary: Morgan Stanley analyst Daniela Haigian has maintained a 'Hold' rating on CarMax, Inc. while increasing the price target from $35 to $53.

market.headline: FirstService Residential Expands Property Management Portfolio in Pennsylvania and New Jersey
market.summary: FirstService Residential has been selected to manage the Bower Hill high-rise community in Mt. Lebanon, Pennsylvania, and the Executive House in Hackensack, New Jersey.

market.headline: GQG Partners Launches GQG Global Equity ETF (GQGG)
market.summary: GQG Partners has launched the GQG Global Equity ETF (NYSE: GQGG), an actively managed fund providing access to the firm's global equity strategy.

market.headline: UBS Adjusts Price Target on DocuSign to $85 From $70, Maintains Neutral Rating
market.summary: UBS analyst Taylor McGinnis has raised the price target for Docusign, Inc. while maintaining a neutral rating on the stock.

market.headline: Pershing Square Inc. to Join Russell 3000 Index
market.summary: Pershing Square Inc. is set to be added to the Russell 3000 index, according to CEO Bill Ackman.

market.headline: Boeing Director Akhil Johri Purchases Shares
market.summary: Boeing Director Akhil Johri acquired 3,000 shares of the company for $500,067 in a transaction reported on November 19, 2026.

market.headline: Citigroup Raises APA Corporation Price Target to $48
market.summary: Citigroup has increased its price target for APA Corporation shares from $44 to $48.

market.headline: Oppenheimer Adjusts Price Target on Modine Manufacturing to $240 From $215
market.summary: Oppenheimer has raised its price target for Modine Manufacturing Company to $240 from $215 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

market.headline: StoneX Initiates Coverage of Deckers Brands with Buy Rating
market.summary: Financial services firm StoneX has initiated coverage on Deckers Brands, assigning the stock a Buy rating with a price target of $110.

market.headline: GameStop CEO Comments on Digital-Only Gaming Trends
market.summary: GameStop's CEO publicly stated that the shift toward digital-only games has negatively impacted consumers, specifically referencing the release of GTA 6 without a physical disc.

market.headline: Techwave and Eurochange (Western Union) Recognized at 2026 ISG Paragon Awards
market.summary: Techwave and Eurochange, a Western Union partner, were named winners of the 'Paragon Champion — Outstanding Business Impact' award at the 2026 ISG Paragon Awards for EMEA.

market.headline: Trulieve Recognized in 2026 Excellence in Action Awards
market.summary: Trulieve Cannabis Corp. was named a winner in the 2026 Excellence in Action Awards by the Brandon Hall Group for its commitment to workplace culture and employee experience.

market.headline: TD SYNNEX Expands HPE Portfolio Access Across 37+ Countries
market.summary: TD SYNNEX has announced the expansion of its full Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) portfolio to partners across more than 37 countries, territories, and regions.

market.headline: Western Union Featured in 'Threads of Connectivity' Documentary Series
market.summary: Western Union is highlighted in the second half of the 'Threads of Connectivity' documentary series, showcasing its role in international money transfers and digital wallet innovation.

market.headline: SentinelOne Partners with Singapore's Defense Cyber Command on Cybersecurity and AI
market.summary: SentinelOne has entered into a collaboration with the Defense Cyber Command (DCCOM) of Singapore's Digital and Intelligence Service to advance cyber defense and secure AI initiatives.

market.headline: PrintKK Partners with Etsy for Print-on-Demand Fulfillment
market.summary: PrintKK has launched an integration with Etsy, allowing sellers to connect their storefronts for automated print-on-demand fulfillment.

market.headline: CoreWeave Co-Founder Purchases $30 Million of Company's Unsecured Bonds
market.summary: CoreWeave co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer Brian Venturo has purchased $30 million in face value of the company's 9.75% senior unsecured notes.

market.headline: CoreWeave and Humatica Release Study on AI-Native Operating Models
market.summary: CoreWeave and Humatica published a sponsored study titled 'AI-Native by Design,' examining how enterprises build lasting value through AI-integrated operating models.

market.headline: Dogfish Head Releases 2026 Holiday Gift Guide
market.summary: The Boston Beer Company subsidiary Dogfish Head has announced its 2026 holiday gift lineup, featuring seasonal beers, spirits, and branded merchandise.

market.headline: National Retail Solutions to Host Networking Lunch for Independent Retailers in New York City
market.summary: National Retail Solutions (NRS), a subsidiary of IDT Corporation, announced it will host a networking event for independent retailers in New York City on December 3, 2026.

market.headline: B. Riley Securities Upgrades AST SpaceMobile to Buy
market.summary: B. Riley Securities analyst Mike Crawford upgraded AST SpaceMobile from Neutral to Buy, maintaining a price target of $48.

market.headline: AllianceBernstein Releases Research on Executive Compensation in the Technology Sector
market.summary: AllianceBernstein published a research report evaluating executive compensation structures within the technology industry, emphasizing the importance of incentive design for long-term shareholder outcomes.

market.headline: Boise Cascade Celebrates Grand Reopening of Expanded Phoenix Distribution Facility
market.summary: Boise Cascade Company has completed a more than $10 million expansion and renovation of its Building Materials Distribution facility in Phoenix, Arizona.

market.headline: Comcast Business Deploys Broadband Connectivity for Digital Cinema Distribution Coalition
market.summary: Comcast Business has completed the installation of high-capacity broadband across 1,200 movie theaters for the Digital Cinema Distribution Coalition (DCDC), a venture co-founded by AMC Theatres.

market.headline: Dream Industrial REIT Announces November 2026 Monthly Distribution
market.summary: Dream Industrial REIT has declared its monthly cash distribution for November 2026, payable to unitholders in December.

market.headline: Solta Medical Surpasses 10 Million Treatments Worldwide
market.summary: Bausch Health's aesthetic business, Solta Medical, has reached a milestone of 10 million treatments performed globally using its technology portfolio.

market.headline: Skeena Resources Limited Announces Board Nomination
market.summary: Skeena Resources Limited has announced the nomination of Mr. Gopaul for election to the company's board of directors.

market.headline: Lemonade Outlines Profitability Milestones and Growth Strategy at Third Investor Day
market.summary: Lemonade, Inc. executives announced plans to achieve a series of profitability milestones over the next three years while maintaining annual growth above 30%.

market.headline: J. Wood Capital Advisors Selects Intapp DealCloud for Relationship Management
market.summary: J. Wood Capital Advisors (JWCA) has chosen the Intapp DealCloud platform to enhance its relationship management and business development operations.

COHR.headline: Coherent Corp. Authorizes $2 Billion Share Repurchase Program
COHR.summary: Coherent Corp. has announced a new share-repurchase program authorizing the buyback of up to $2 billion of its common stock.

PDD.headline: PDD Holdings Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
PDD.summary: PDD Holdings reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting stable revenues and continued strategic investment in supply chain capabilities.

STX.headline: Stalexport Autostrady Subsidiary Announces Planned Group Layoffs
STX.summary: Stalexport Autostrada Małopolska S.A., a subsidiary of Stalexport Autostrady S.A., has passed a resolution to initiate a group layoff procedure due to the upcoming expiration of its motorway concession.

BE.headline: BMO Capital Upgrades Bloom Energy to Outperform
BE.summary: BMO Capital has upgraded Bloom Energy Corporation's stock rating from Market Perform to Outperform, setting a price target of $230.

BE.headline: Bloom Energy Named to TIME's List of America's Top Manufacturers of 2027
BE.summary: Bloom Energy has been recognized by TIME and Statista as one of America's Top Manufacturers of 2027, highlighting its role in the electrical equipment sector.

P.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Everpure Following Q3 Results
P.summary: Financial analysts at Piper Sandler and Barclays updated their price targets for Everpure, Inc. on November 19, 2026, following the company's third-quarter earnings report.

INTC.headline: Fubon Securities Adjusts Price Target on Intel
INTC.summary: Fubon Securities has revised its price target for Intel Corporation, lowering it from $105 to $66.

INTC.headline: Intel Secures First External Customer for 18A Chip Technology
INTC.summary: Intel has announced it has signed its first external customer for its advanced 18A manufacturing process node.

NTES.headline: NetEase Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Declares Dividend
NTES.summary: NetEase, Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting a decline in revenue and net income, while also approving a quarterly dividend.

WMG.headline: Warner Music Group Reports Fiscal Q4 2026 Financial Results
WMG.summary: Warner Music Group announced its fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $2.00 billion and adjusted earnings per share of $0.55.

WMT.headline: Walmart Raises Fiscal Year Guidance Amid 3Q Earnings Beat
WMT.summary: Walmart reported fiscal third-quarter results that surpassed analyst expectations and increased its full-year earnings and sales growth outlook.

NVS.headline: Jefferies Maintains Hold Rating on Novartis
NVS.summary: Analyst firm Jefferies & Company Inc. has maintained its 'Hold' rating on Novartis shares with a price target of 125 Swiss francs following the company's updated midterm outlook.

NVS.headline: Novartis Announces Mid-Term Growth Targets and Pipeline Updates at Investor Day
NVS.summary: Novartis has set a target for 5% average annual sales growth through 2031 and aims to restore core profit margins to over 40% by 2029.

UL.headline: Activists Launch Campaign Targeting Unilever Over Animal Welfare Standards
UL.summary: Non-profit organization Sinergia Animal launched a campaign in London on November 19, 2026, calling on Unilever to adopt consistent global animal welfare standards for its supply chain.

KO.headline: BC Bottle and Recycling Depot Association Launches Campaign Challenging Beverage Giants
KO.summary: The BC Bottle and Recycling Depot Association has launched a campaign called 'Reject-It.ca' to challenge The Coca-Cola Company and other beverage giants over alleged underpayment and threatened closures of independent bottle depots.

BTI.headline: British American Tobacco Recognized as Paragon Contender at 2026 ISG Paragon Awards
BTI.summary: British American Tobacco was honored as a 'Paragon Contender' for 'Consistent High Performance' at the 2026 ISG Paragon Awards for the EMEA region.

NKE.headline: Nike Extends Partnership with Bank of America Chicago Marathon Through 2036
NKE.summary: Nike and the Bank of America Chicago Marathon have announced a long-term extension of their partnership, continuing their collaboration through 2036.

NKE.headline: Nike Faces Analyst Skepticism Following Investor Day Outlook
NKE.summary: Nike shares faced pressure following the company's Investor Day, where analysts expressed concerns regarding the company's long-term outlook and projected sales declines in fiscal year 2028.

NKE.headline: Nike to Provide Sneakers to U.S. High School Valedictorians
NKE.summary: Nike announced an initiative to provide custom sneakers to high school valedictorians across the United States for the 2026/2027 school year.

GIS.headline: General Mills to Webcast Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Earnings Results on December 17, 2026
GIS.summary: General Mills, Inc. has scheduled the release of its fiscal 2027 second-quarter financial results for December 17, 2026.
